### 🟢 Approval recommended The memo invalidation condition is narrowed in a way that matches the dictionary’s append-only/inlining behavior and is covered by focused tests across the relevant graph modes (dense/sparse/forked/mapped).
Pull request overview This PR optimizes `sparq-core` update handling by preserving the cached “high precision decimal present” memo when `apply_delta` does not add any new *stored* dictionary terms, avoiding repeated dictionary-wide scans on subsequent numeric-filter safety checks (Issue #6485). **Changes:** - Update `Graph::apply_delta_mem` to only invalidate `high_precision_decimal` when the dictionary length increases. - Add regression tests covering delete-only updates, known-term reinsertion, inline-integer insertion (no dict growth), stored-term growth invalidation, and fork/compact/snapshot/WAL replay scenarios. - Add a V2 feature-off wasm bundle change intent declaration for PR #6486.
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | crates/sparq-core/src/lib.rs | Preserve `high_precision_decimal` memo across dictionary-preserving deltas; add targeted tests for memo preservation/invalidation across in-memory and mmap/WAL paths. | | bench/feature-off-declarations/6486.json | Declare intentional always-compiled change for the feature-OFF wasm bundle comparison gate (V2 mechanism). |
